narrative.headline: Check Japan journeys with dated routes, explicit fares and source-backed pass constraints.
narrative.value_prop: Resolve stations and places, compare source route alternatives, and inspect legs without losing dates or fare assumptions. Responses are bounded, compact JSON with source and freshness metadata.
narrative.auth_narrative: The verified Japan Travel website surface requires no API key or subscription. Runtime uses Firefox-compatible HTTP; no running browser or imported cookies.
